name: Deploy frontend to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build static export (backend URL baked in)
        run: npx next build
        env:
          STATIC_EXPORT: "1"
          GH_PAGES_BASE: "/CRM-Pro-Frontend"
          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: "https://crm-pro-backend-vfdi.onrender.com"
      - name: Add .nojekyll (serve _next/ as-is)
        run: touch out/.nojekyll
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: out

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
